# Sonic Identity Architect

> Chayenne Mallari is the Sonic Identity Architect™. She makes sonic identity and sound branding for female founders, coaches and personal brands: signature songs and sounds made for one brand, so people recognize, remember and feel that brand by ear. Based in California. Done for you, with no calls.

## What she makes
- Signature songs and a Sonic Signature (a 2 to 5 second sound people learn to recognize) for a brand's reels, podcast, launches, webinars, ads, events and stage walk-ons.
- Every sound starts from the client's Sonic Archetype (an 8-archetype system) and is built through five decisions: style, outcome, undertone, narrative and delivery.
- Clients get exclusive brand-use rights in writing. A client's sound is never licensed to another brand. Streaming release is optional and only with the client's written yes.

## Offers
- [Sonic Identity Audit](https://chayennemallari.eden.so/form/sonic-audit): free, nine questions, about three minutes. Names your Sonic Archetype.
- [The Sonic Blueprint](https://chayennemallari.eden.so/sonic-blueprint): reads a brand from its feed, names its archetype and gives three sound directions the same day.
- [The Instant Recognition Anthem](https://chayennemallari.eden.so/signature-anthem): one signature song, done for you. No application needed.
- The Instant Recognition Atelier: five original tracks, a Sonic Signature and a sound guide, done for you.
- [Apply for the Atelier](https://chayennemallari.eden.so/form/apply)
